headline: Seres Therapeutics Posts Q3 Earnings Beat, Revenue Falls Short
summary: Seres Therapeutics reported third-quarter earnings per share that beat estimates by $0.01, while revenue fell short of consensus projections.
why: Seres Therapeutics is a biotechnology firm focused on microbiome therapeutics, making its financial results important for clinical-stage biotech valuations.

impacts.name: Seres Therapeutics
impacts.why: Mixed results with an EPS beat and revenue miss create divergent signals for equity valuation.
